create_scannet_dataset: create a Scannet dataset instance with train split, custom resolution, and sequence count
load_scannet_scenes: load all ScanNet scenes from a split file or custom test IDs into the dataset
get_scannet_views: get RGB images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics for sampled frames in a scene
sample_scannet_frames: sample frames from a ScanNet sequence using min/max threshold constraints and randomization
review_scannet_dataset: review the Scannet class to understand its dataset loading, frame sampling, and view retrieval logic
